title: GSK3beta and Plk1 sequentially phosphorylate ATP-citrate lyase to promote homologous recombination.
authors: Zhou, Shinan; Zhou, Xinyu; Chen, Qinfu; Yuan, Xueying; Zhu, Shukai; Huang, Jun; Wang, Fangwei; Yan, Haiyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究激酶磷酸化级联调控ACLY促进同源重组修复，属于DNA损伤修复信号通路与代谢调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Accurate repair of DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) by homologous recombination (HR) is essential for genome stability. Nuclear production of acetyl-coenzyme A (acetyl-CoA) by ATP-citrate lyase (ACLY) promotes HR, yet how ACLY is regulated during the DNA damage response (DDR) remains unclear. Here, we identify a phosphorylation-dependent signaling axis in which glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (GSK3beta) and Polo-like kinase 1 (Plk1) act sequentially on ACLY to facilitate HR-mediated repair of DSBs induced by ionizing radiation. Following AKT-dependent phosphorylation of ACLY at Ser(455), GSK3beta phosphorylates ACLY at Thr(447), generating a docking site for Plk1, which in turn phosphorylates ACLY at Ser(442). This phosphorylation cascade, enhanced by radiation, sustains histone acetylation, supports the accumulation of BRCA1 and RAD51 at DSBs, and confers cellular resistance to poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibition. Together, our findings define an AKT-GSK3beta-Plk1-ACLY signaling module that links the DDR to nuclear metabolism, revealing a critical mechanism by which kinase signaling facilitates acetyl-CoA-dependent chromatin remodeling to preserve genome integrity.
abstract_zh: 通过同源重组（HR）精确修复DNA双链断裂（DSBs）对于基因组稳定性至关重要。ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶（ACLY）在细胞核中产生的乙酰辅酶A（acetyl-CoA）促进HR，然而在DNA损伤应答（DDR）过程中ACLY如何被调控仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了一个磷酸化依赖性信号轴，其中糖原合成酶激酶3β（GSK3beta）和Polo样激酶1（Plk1）依次作用于ACLY，以促进电离辐射诱导的DSBs的HR介导修复。在AKT依赖性磷酸化ACLY的Ser(455)位点后，GSK3beta磷酸化ACLY的Thr(447)位点，为Plk1生成对接位点，后者进而磷酸化ACLY的Ser(442)位点。这一磷酸化级联反应，受辐射增强，维持组蛋白乙酰化，支持BRCA1和RAD51在DSBs处的积累，并赋予细胞对聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制的抗性。总之，我们的发现定义了一个AKT-GSK3beta-Plk1-ACLY信号模块，将DDR与核代谢联系起来，揭示了激酶信号传导促进乙酰辅酶A依赖性染色质重塑以维持基因组完整性的关键机制。
